Physical and engineering constraints on Universal Physical Artifact Verification System.

Data standards are fragmented. Verification needs trusted measurements. Legacy artifacts lack digital pedigrees.

Scale analysis across 3 quantities spans 6 orders of magnitude; the dominant scale separation is tracked parts vs verification time at 6 orders of magnitude (tracked parts larger). Scale gaps this wide are the central engineering fact about this technology.
